title: Deep-Fought Night Reflection
prompt: Describe a deep emotional night you experienced and how it affected you.
hint: Think about a night that was intense or meaningful, and explain your feelings and thoughts during that time.
sample: Two weeks ago, I had a deep-fought night that changed how I see my life. It was full of memories and emotions that I still carry with me.

ja.prompt: あなたが経験した深く感情的な夜について説明し、その夜があなたにどのような影響を与えたかを書いてください。
ja.hint: 強烈または意味深い夜について考え、その時の感情や思いを説明しましょう。
ja.sample: 二週間前、私は人生観を変えるような深い夜を過ごしました。その夜は思い出と感情で満ちていて、今でも心に残っています。

local.prompt: Describe a deep emotional night you experienced and how it affected you.

local.sample: Two weeks ago, I had a deep-fought night that changed how I see my life. It was full of memories and emotions that I still carry with me.

zh.prompt: 描述你經歷過的一個深刻情感的夜晚，以及它如何影響了你。
zh.hint: 想想一個強烈或有意義的夜晚，並解釋你當時的感受和想法。
zh.sample: 兩週前，我經歷了一個深刻的夜晚，改變了我看待生活的方式。那晚充滿了回憶和情感，我至今仍然記得。

en.prompt: Describe a deep emotional night you experienced and how it affected you.
en.hint: Think about a night that was intense or meaningful, and explain your feelings and thoughts during that time.
en.sample: Two weeks ago, I had a deep-fought night that changed how I see my life. It was full of memories and emotions that I still carry with me.

title: Memories and Silence
prompt: Write about a memory that you keep locked away and how silence affects you.
hint: Consider a past experience you rarely talk about and describe the role silence plays in your feelings about it.
sample: I called your name and saw the parts of me I locked away. Now I'm drowned in the silence of the life I have to save.

ja.prompt: あまり話さない過去の記憶について書き、その記憶に対する沈黙があなたの感情にどのような影響を与えているか説明してください。
ja.hint: 普段は話さない経験を思い出し、その沈黙が感情にどのように関わっているかを考えましょう。
ja.sample: あなたの名前を呼び、心に閉じ込めていた自分の一部を見ました。今は救わなければならない人生の沈黙に溺れています。

local.prompt: Write about a memory that you keep locked away and how silence affects you.
local.hint: Consider a past experience you rarely talk about and describe the role silence plays in your feelings about it.
local.sample: I called your name and saw the parts of me I locked away. Now I'm drowned in the silence of the life I have to save.

zh.prompt: 寫下你封存的記憶，以及沉默如何影響你的感受。
zh.hint: 想想你很少談論的過去經歷，描述沉默在你對那段經歷的感受中扮演的角色。
zh.sample: 我呼喚你的名字，看見了我封存的自己。現在我淹沒在必須拯救的生命的沉默中。

en.prompt: Write about a memory that you keep locked away and how silence affects you.
en.hint: Consider a past experience you rarely talk about and describe the role silence plays in your feelings about it.
en.sample: I called your name and saw the parts of me I locked away. Now I'm drowned in the silence of the life I have to save.

title: Unspoken Words and Feelings
prompt: Express how unspoken words can impact relationships and personal emotions.
hint: Think about times when you or someone else didn't say something important and how that affected you.
sample: They played my favorite song on guitar while the fireflies went by. Told me how my voice saved you and the world went dark and cold.

ja.prompt: 言葉にできなかったことが人間関係や感情にどのような影響を与えるかを書いてください。
ja.hint: 自分や他人が重要なことを言わなかった時のことを考え、それがどのように影響したか説明しましょう。
ja.sample: 蛍が飛び交う中、私の好きな曲がギターで演奏されました。あなたを救った私の声の話を聞き、世界は暗く冷たくなりました。

zh.prompt: 表達未說出口的話如何影響人際關係和個人情感。
zh.hint: 想想你或別人沒有說出重要話語的時候，這對你有什麼影響。
zh.sample: 當螢火蟲飛過時，他們彈奏我最喜歡的吉他曲。告訴我我的聲音救了你，而世界變得黑暗寒冷。

en.sample: They played my favorite song on guitar while the fireflies went by. Told me how my voice saved you and the world went dark and cold.

title: Letting Go and Moving On
prompt: Describe a moment when you had to let go of someone or something and how you felt.
hint: Think about the emotions involved in saying goodbye or moving forward from a past experience.
sample: I packed my suitcase, slowly folding all the things I never say. You kissed the tears, laid off my cheeks and let me walk away.

ja.prompt: 誰かや何かを手放さなければならなかった瞬間と、その時の気持ちを説明してください。
ja.hint: 別れや過去の経験から前に進む時の感情について考えましょう。
ja.sample: 私はスーツケースを詰め、言えなかったことをゆっくりと折りたたみました。あなたは涙にキスをし、頬からそれを拭い、私を見送ってくれました。

local.sample: I packed my suitcase, slowly folding all the things I never say. You kissed the tears, laid off my cheeks and let me walk away.

zh.prompt: 描述你必須放手某人或某事的時刻，以及你的感受。
zh.hint: 想想說再見或從過去經歷中前進時的情感。
zh.sample: 我收拾行李，慢慢折疊那些我從未說出口的話。你吻著我的淚水，拭去我的臉頰，讓我離開。
